'''Olaf''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] who resided in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], around the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was a patron of the [[Thirsty Bantha]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].
